components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and address. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the canonical region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned when an owner joins a household (same last name and address) via 'sharesHousehold'. All owners of the same household share this value.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. Two owners collide (409 on create) only when their whole identityKey is equal."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||H-3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level assigned on creation, from 1 to 3. Starts at 1; add 1 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode (the region-and-hash identity)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region, taken as the REGION part of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'); this is the region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback: Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves."

## Summary

I implemented soft ("possible") duplicate detection for `POST /api/owners`. A new owner that isn't a hard identity duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` and `postcode` with a *different* telephone is still created, and its response now reports `possibleDuplicate: true` with `possibleDuplicateOf` set to the matching owner's id (otherwise `possibleDuplicate: false`, `possibleDuplicateOf: null`).

Changes made, following the OfficeFloor function-injection conventions in AGENTS.md:

- **New pipeline step** `FlagPossibleDuplicate.java` — reads the built `@Val Owner`, scans `OwnerRepository.findAll()` for a same-lastName (normalized) + same-postcode + different-telephone owner, and sets the flags (lowest matching id when several match; a missing postcode never matches).
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired `flagPossibleDuplicate` in after `ensureUniqueIdentity` (which still rejects hard duplicates with 409) and before `save`, under `govern: [ transaction ]`, so the flags persist.
- **`Owner.java`** — added `possibleDuplicate` (Boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (Integer) columns with accessors.
- **schema.sql** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added `possible_duplicate` / `possible_duplicate_of` columns.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the two `readOnly` response fields to the `Owner` schema (regenerates the DTO).
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — ignored the two new targets on the request→entity mapping; the entity→DTO mapping picks them up automatically by name.

Note: the escalation path is unchanged — this is a soft flag on a successfully created owner (201), not an error, so no new handler was needed.
